newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CanWest confirms wants all of NZ's TV3.
newsitem.headline: CanWest confirms wants all of NZ's TV3.

text.p: CanWest Global Communications Corp confirmed on Thursday it planned to move to 100 percent ownership of New Zealand's TV3 network.

"It's a good business for us...It's a great business environment. We're quite happy with New Zealand, have been happy with it in the past and we're just expanding our operation in that country," Gerald Noble, Vice-President, Operations, told Radio New Zealand in an interview.
"The plan is ultimately to own 100 percent, yes."
CanWest earlier said it had agreed with New Zealand-based Westpac Communications Ltd to acquire Westpac's 50 percent equity interest in TV3 for NZ$78.8 million, payable on September 2, 1997.

On completion of the acquisition, CanWest will own 68 percent of TV3 shares and hold options for the remaining 32 percent. Westpac Communications is a subsidiary of Westpac Banking Corp and acquired the stake when TV3 was placed in receivership.
